title: docs(investigations): CAM orchestrator recovery evidence (evidence only)
intent: Determine whether the archived 2026-03-18 neck-CAM orchestrator is a predecessor or partial fix for the neck rapid-at-cutting-depth defect. Evidence only; no production behaviour changes. The March 2026 consolidation census was split out to its own draft PR (#442).
behavior_change: None. No file under services/api/app, packages/client, workflows, configs or baselines is modified. Adds investigation documents, per-arm replay records, metrics and line excerpts (full G-code programs are not committed), the replay harness and a rebuild-and-verify tool, the read-only motion parser under scripts/investigations/, and one test module. Findings: 702 rapids below Z0 on the pre-#398 tree with or without the archived orchestrator (#398 fixed the defect); the orchestrator cannot run on the current machine contract and duplicates tool changes. Owner ruling: SUPERSEDED / INCOMPATIBLE_WITH_CURRENT_RUNTIME / DO_NOT_FORWARD_PORT.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Orchestrator evidence directory, replay records with recorded program hashes, metrics and excerpts, replay/regenerate_programs.py (rebuilds the four programs from pinned history and verifies hashes and metrics.json), the modal G-code motion parser, and 14 table-driven tests covering the parser and the agreement of every record.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No prior record tested the archived orchestrator against the defect or established that 702 (not 780) is the reproducible count.
